Image Generation

Turn a text description into a real, on-brand image file.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Produces a real PNG from a description: a report hero image, a poster or flyer, a social or OG card, a background, or a contextual photo for a deck or document. It picks the right model, writes the prompt from tested craft rules, matches the palette to your brand, and hands back the finished file. You describe what you want in the frame; it handles the rest.

When to use it

Any time a piece of work needs artwork rather than a diagram: a hero image for a report, a header for a newsletter or blog post, a share card, or a photo to set the scene in a deck. Not for flowcharts, charts, or architecture diagrams (those render as gibberish - use a diagram tool), and not for a final production logo (concepts only, refined in Figma).

How to trigger it

"make a hero image for the Q3 report"

"generate a header image for this newsletter"

"create a share card for this post"
